race.title: More Radio Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: In a weak race, EPHYRA is chanced from a mark that looks workable on last season’s course second given she should be sharper for her recent return. In-form chase winner Golly Gosh is feared most despite stamina concerns at this longer trip, with Anothermanicmonday also respected. EPHYRA GOLLY GOSH (IRE) ANOTHERMANICMONDAY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Golly Gosh (2/1), Anothermanicmonday (7/2), Alan Bresil (5/1), Of Corse I Can (5/1), Athena's Dream (10/1), Jurassic Pet (12/1), Good Girl Rachel (14/1), Ephyra (25/1)
